Trigger.Title: Cut-in Settings
Trigger.TokenPickerInfo: Click a token on the scene to select it.

Key.SupportTriggerHelp: Support: A trigger used to refine conditions. Don't function on its own.

Container.Label: Container Memo
Container.Description: Group multiple triggers into a container.

ChatMessage.Label: Keyword
ChatMessage.Description: Triggers based on a specific keyword in a chat message.

DiceRollTotal.Description: Triggers based on the total result of a dice roll.

DiceRollDice.Description: Triggers based on the individual dice results of a roll.

DiceRollFormula.Description: Triggers based on the formula of a dice roll.

CombatStart.Description: Triggers when a combat starts. End triggers using NOT.

RoundStart.Description: Triggers when a combat round starts. End triggers using NOT.
RoundStart.GreaterThan: Round Greater Than or Equal To
RoundStart.LessThan: Round Less Than or Equal To

TurnStart.Description: Triggers when a combat turn starts. End triggers using NOT.

CutinPlayback.Description: Triggers when another cut-in is played.

MessageType.Description: Triggers based on the type of chat message. Liimits chat message, Roll Total, Dice, Dice Formula.

TriggeringCharacter.Description: Triggers based on the executing character. Limits Chat Message, Roll Total, Dice, Roll Formula, Turn Start, and Turn Active triggers.

TriggeringPlayer.Description: Triggers based on the user who initiated the action. Limits Chat Message, Roll Total, Dice, Roll Formula, Turn Start, and Turn Active triggers.

Target.Description: Triggers based on the user's target selection.

ExportDialog.ConfirmationText: Export cut-ins to a JSON file?
ExportDialog.ConfirmationTextAll: Export all cut-ins to a JSON file.

ImportDialog.AddDescription: New cut-ins will be added to the existing list. You can choose to skip or rename cut-ins with duplicate IDs.
ImportDialog.OverwriteDescription: All existing cut-ins will be deleted and replaced with the imported cut-ins. This action cannot be undone.

Cleanup.ConfirmContent:
Found {count} unused triggers.

Are you sure you want to delete them? This action cannot be undone.

PlayerPermission.Name: Allow Players to View Cut-ins list
PlayerPermission.Hint: ON: Players can view the cut-in list and play from cut-in list.  OFF: Players can only play cut-ins by triggers.

ImageDuration.Name: Standard Duration for Image (ms)
ImageDuration.Hint: Sets the duration for a single playback when the cut-in is a still image. If repeated, this duration will be used for each repetition.

Cleanup.Name: Cleanup Unused Data
Cleanup.Hint: Scans and removes unused data from Cut-in Manager.
Cleanup.Label: Cleanup

ShowTriggerDescription.Name: Show Trigger Descriptions
ShowTriggerDescription.Hint: If enabled, a brief description for each trigger type will be shown in the cut-in settings window.

Notifications.OverwriteImportSuccess: Successfully overwritten all cut-ins. {count} cut-ins imported.
Notifications.AllCutinsHalted: All cut-ins have been stopped and disabled.
Notifications.ChangesStaged: Changes have been staged. Save the main cut-in settings to make them permanent.
Notifications.OrphansFound: Cut-in Manager | {count} unused data were found. You can run a cleanup.
Notifications.NoOrphansFound: No unused data found. Everything is clean!

Error.AlreadyExists: That ID is already in use.
